About this item
❤️ High Quality Mason Jars: Anwoi mason jars are made of durable and 100% BPA free food grade glass. The scale mark design to let you can accurate grasp of capacity. The stylish see-through design let you see the food at a glance, the non-slip round bottom design allows you to use it more comfortably, safely, and better organize your kitchen.

❤️ Concern Free Purchase: Accidents may happen during the long shipping process. If you get broken glass mason jars, please feel free to contact us and we will reply you within 24 hours and provide a satisfactory solution so that you can buy with confidence. reviews_5s:
Beautiful jars. I use them for making homemade yogurt. They hold a half gallon each. Suitable for refrigerator or pantry. But do NOT put boiling water in them. I got a hairline crack in one when I poured boiling water in it for a large batch of tea. It does fine with generally hot temperatures, just not boiling water.

The lid and clasp work great and are sealed tight even for liquids. I haven’t shaken them with liquids, but they have been tipped over and not leaked.Homestead here I come! Great jars for storage. Perfect size needed and even better value for the money! If only the homesteading would be an amazon click away with these jars! Good quality all around! Love a good jar!!Love them, sturdy and cleans up the clutter of my baking cupboard.Glass is taller than I thought and the opening fits my hand in the jar to scoop out my flour/sugar. I’m satisfied with this purchaseThese jars have a clean and uniform presentation. Love the air tight closures.Great big sizeI love these jars! So versatile. I use them with a sealer to keep larger quantities fresh.Love the wide opening as I use them for storage in my kitchen.Great jars!!As expected.
